question_en: How many CRs list TS 38.214 as a cross-spec impact target, and which are representative?
original_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) WITH sp, collect(cr.tdocNumber) AS crList, count(cr) AS crCount RETURN sp.specNumber, crCount, crList[..10] AS sampleCRs
reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) WHERE NOT (toLower(coalesce(cr.reasonForChange, '')) CONTAINS 'other core') WITH sp, collect(cr.tdocNumber) AS crList, count(cr) AS crCount RETURN sp.specNumber, crCount, crList[..10] AS sampleCRs
